profile.name: 通用USB设备通信后端接口
profile.name_en: Generic USB Device Communication Backend Interface
profile.description: 这是一个面向通用USB设备的通信后端接口，用于在系统中枚举USB设备、读取各类USB描述符、打开与关闭设备连接，并执行控制传输、批量传输、中断传输和等时传输。它常用于实验室软件与各种通过USB连接的仪器、控制器或数据采集设备之间建立底层通信。
profile.description_en: This is a generic communication backend interface for USB devices. It is used to enumerate USB devices on a system, read USB descriptors, open and close device connections, and perform control, bulk, interrupt, and isochronous transfers. It is commonly used as a low-level communication layer between laboratory software and USB-connected instruments, controllers, or data acquisition devices.

registry.name: I
registry.description: I Backend是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括传输、关闭、写入数据、复位、打开、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, attach kernel driver等操作。
